import sys,subprocess,json,os
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/backups/disk2/projects/blent'); sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts/coverage'))
import ast,re,shlex
module=ast.parse((root/'scripts/coverage/gpu_check.py').read_text())
selected=[node for node in module.body if isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in {'cases','sdk_flags'}]
ROOT=root
PACKAGES='libavcodec libavutil libva libdrm x11 x11-xcb xrandr xfixes xdamage xrender xext xcb-dri3'.split()
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=selected,type_ignores=[]),'existing-gpu-cases','exec'))
out=Path('/backups/disk2/blent-work/2026-10-27-c-review')
rows=[]
for name,sources,flags,expected in cases(sdk_flags()):
 binary=out/('gpu-'+name)
 command=['gcc','-std=c11','-D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L','-DFF_PROFILE_H264_CONSTRAINED_BASELINE=AV_PROFILE_H264_CONSTRAINED_BASELINE','-O1','-g','-fsanitize=address,undefined','-fno-sanitize-recover=all','-fno-pie','-no-pie',*sources,*flags,'-o',str(binary)]
 with (out/('gpu-'+name+'.log')).open('w') as log:
  built=subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  result=None
  if built.returncode==0: result=subprocess.run([str(binary)],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
 rows.append(dict(name=name,build=built.returncode,exit=result,expected=expected))
 print(rows[-1],flush=True)
(out/'gpu-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
